page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin notes at the right, beside the lines "ualidos mendicos" and "Ministri Ecclesiae"; signature at the foot.

p.i: peres ad certos labores cogat, veluti ad publica aedificia extruenda, et alia, neq; otiosos ferat. Item vt ualidos mendicos,

qui laborare nolunt, ditione sua pellat, ne oneri sint agri-colis & alijs. Saepe enim fit, vt illi obseruent absentiam virorum in villis solitarijs, minis-que adigant familiam illorum, vt carnes suil-las, & alia eis conferant. Tales instar lupo-rum prosequendi sunt, vt laboriosi & verè pauperes melius necessaria habere possint. Tempore Apostol. eleemosynae collectae sunt, quibus tempore famis, fidelium in dissitis locis paupertas posset subleuari. Paulus non dedignatus est pauperibus Hierosolymitanis afferre eleemosynam, quam in Macedonia & Achaia fideles collegerant. Diligenter in suis Epistolis Ecclesias hortatur, vt sibi pauperes commendatos habeant.

Ministri Ecclesiae, populū sibi commissum pro cōcione docere debet ex verbo Dei quod fertilitas sit Dei donū: item quas ob causas Deus famem immittat: inuitare eū debent ad poenitentiam, pauperes confirmare & erigere, diuites adhortari, vt largas eis

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "debet" (possibly with a macron over e, not clearly visible); "donū" (tilde over u uncertain). "minis-que" is shown with a hyphen at the line end, rendered here as printed. The first word "peres" is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The running head and page number are as printed. The whole page is set in italic type; the margin notes are in roman.
